_doc: Workflows for bin/session-run. A session names one (default chat). Edits are picked up on the next turn. Placeholders: {PULT} = this checkout, {WORK} = its state dir, {HOME}. permission_mode: 'acceptEdits' keeps chat safe by default (edits ok, other tools denied headless); switch to 'bypassPermissions' only if you accept an agent that can run anything on this Mac from your phone.

draft._doc: EVERY event that carries an item_id (card button, «More», reply to a card) runs here, never in `chat`: read and draft only, enforced by the tool rules, not by the prompt. dontAsk denies whatever is not allowed. A fresh Claude session every time (never resumes the chat session, so quoted inbox text cannot ride into a more permissive session). The deny list is checked first. Add your own read-only commands to allowed_tools (a mail search, a notes lookup); never add a command that sends.

_doc_transcribers: Voice notes are turned into text before the model sees them. argv with {audio} and {outdir}; the tool must write <outdir>/<audio stem>.txt. mlx_whisper (Apple silicon, `uv tool install mlx-whisper`) is the example; use any CLI that does the same.
